selection_rationale.mechanism_quality: high: prior-range breakout/trend persistence has explicit payer/constraint and falsification contract
selection_rationale.source_method_fidelity: high: closed-bar Donchian transition + directional structure + ATR risk geometry are owned by the rebuilt policy
selection_rationale.native_source_readiness: high: public BingX perpetual OHLCV endpoint is sufficient for first policy evaluation; no private account data required
selection_rationale.expected_move_vs_cost: policy requires move_budget/cost >= 1.5 before emitting tradable intent; conservative all-taker fee authority is retained
selection_rationale.event_rate: moderate: 1h breakout transition avoids micro-scalp fee dominance and excessive turnover
selection_rationale.falsifiability: strong: direction flip, time placebo, regime permutation/delayed-entry style controls plus no-trade/cost budget checks
selection_rationale.redundancy: selected as canonical trend-breakout representative; structurally similar trend variants remain queued until this lane resolves

cost_authority.funding: included only when a holding interval crosses a settlement and an authoritative rate is available; otherwise fail-closed/exclude
